description: Search 13M parallel sentences across 429 languages (CC-BY 2.0 FR). Filter by source language, optional translation language, audio availability, and free-text keyword. Sort by relevance/random/created/modified. Tatoeba

has_audio.description: Filter to sentences that have a human audio recording attached.

language.description: ISO 639-3 language code of the source sentence (default "eng"). Use tatoeba.languages to discover codes.

query.description: Optional keyword search inside sentence text.

translation_lang.description: ISO 639-3 code of a target language — only return sentences that have a translation into this language.

name: language.tatoeba.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Tatoeba Sentences
